mapper.select: SELECT topic_id, group_session_id, root_message_id, last_message_id, last_activity_at, create_time FROM byai_group_chat_topic WHERE group_session_id = #{sessionId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO byai_group_chat_topic target USING (SELECT CAST(#{topicId} AS BIGINT) AS topic_id, CAST(#{groupSessionId} AS BIGINT) AS group_session_id, CAST(#{rootMessageId} AS BIGINT) AS root_message_id, CAST(#{lastMessageId} AS BIGINT) AS last_message_id, CAST(#{lastActivityAt} AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS last_activity_at, CAST(#{createTime} AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS create_time) source ON (target.topic_id = source.topic_id AND target.group_session_id = source.group_session_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET last_message_id = CASE WHEN source.last_activity_at > target.last_activity_at OR (source.last_activity_at = target.last_activity_at AND source.last_message_id > target.last_message_id) THEN source.last_message_id ELSE target.last_message_id END, last_activity_at = CASE WHEN source.last_activity_at > target.last_activity_at THEN source.last_activity_at ELSE target.last_activity_at END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (topic_id, group_session_id, root_message_id, last_message_id, last_activity_at, create_time) VALUES (source.topic_id, source.group_session_id, source.root_message_id, source.last_message_id, source.last_activity_at, source.create_time)
